#!/bin/bash
# Halvorsen Labs - rsch-ws-02
# log rotation helper
#
# Rotates and compresses logs under /var/log/halvorsen/ and
# /home/research/scratch/logs/ for the weekly maintenance run.
# Safe to run at any time; does not touch running processes.
# Output is written to /var/log/halvorsen/rotate.log.

LOG_DIRS="/var/log/halvorsen /home/research/scratch/logs"
for d in $LOG_DIRS; do
  logrotate -s /tmp/rotate.state -f "$d/logrotate.conf" 2>/dev/null
done
logger -t log-rotate "weekly log rotation complete"
